text:
Sam Holt: Morning  need one final pass on R3 scope. Customers ask for concrete ROI: batching, cache hints, quant presets, eval-alerts. We should agree which to ship as runtime vs advisory.
Yara Ibrahim: My take: ship batching heuristics as the single runtime change (opt-in), everything else as advisory + Console cards. Minimizes blast radius.
Ben Cho: +1. Suggest we define explicit rollback thresholds: if p99 increases >10% for 5m, auto-disable for that customer route.
Dina Morales: Compliance customers require audit logs + a human-readable rationale for each rec. We can synthesize from rule metadata. Keep it short.
Sam Holt: Acceptance criteria candidate: 3 pilot customers, visible per-route cost/latency deltas in Console, adoption rate >=20%, p99 regression <=10% for enrolled routes, eval-alert FP <8%.
Yara Ibrahim: Timeline proposal: Week A: schema + DSL; Week B: runtime prototype (2 heuristics) + perf; Week C: telemetry + Console stub; Week D: pilot rollout + metrics.
Ben Cho: Runtime heuristics to prototype: sticky-prefix and paced-microbatch. No kernel changes in MVP.
Dina Morales: For advisory quant recs: presets = [fp16, int8-ff], include expected savings and risk note. Provide CSV export for audits.
Sam Holt: Dev owners: runtime = Ben, infra/telemetry = Yara, Console/pilot UX = Dina. Agree?
Yara Ibrahim: agree. I'll add telemetry events: opt.r3.eval, opt.r3.suggest, opt.r3.apply, opt.r3.alert. Include rule_id, route, before_tokens_est, after_tokens_est, p95_before.
Ben Cho: Blocker: eng-runtime capacity for perf tuning. If blocked, we'll deploy user-space scheduler gateway as fallback. I'll raise perf-run request.
Dina Morales: Runbook note: ops to define noisy-alert thresholds and support contact. Pilot customers need direct escalation channel.
prod-bot: Poll created "R3 ship stance" options: [batching-first, advisory-first, alerts-first] Vote at https://redwood.internal/poll/14007
Sam Holt: Final call for this thread: R3 = batching heuristics (opt-in with rollback), quant/cache as advisory with templated rationale + audit rows, eval-alerts = read-only in Console. Ship spec unless objections by EOD. :thumbsup:
Yara Ibrahim: +1
Ben Cho: +1
Dina Morales: +1
